_comment: The ONE model Prism calls. It routes, it never answers — it reads a question and decides which of the student's browser AIs is best placed to answer it. Routing is a classification job, so it is asked for JSON and for minimal reasoning. Verify current model IDs at console.groq.com/docs/models before changing.
_router_fallbacks_note: Tried in order if the primary has no key or fails. All optional — with none configured, routing falls back to keywords and the product still works.
